text: Shipping options: pick-up (0 €) or size-dependent shipping
description: Pick-up (0 €) or shipping priced from painting size. shared/shipping.ts uses Österreichische Post tariff 1 Jul 2026: Paket Österreich by weight (6.61–21.13 €) + großes Sperrgut (+20/24 €) when longer than 100×60 cm, up to 200 cm; Paket Plus International zone 1b (19.01–83.40 €) up to 100×60 cm. Package = painting + 10 cm, weight ≈ 1.5 kg + 8 kg/m², + 8 € packaging. Larger: pick-up only.

status.comment: Commit 1e97e54. Examples: 30×40 → AT 18 € / EU 34 €; 60×80 → AT 42 €, no EU; 150×200 → pick-up only. Sperrgut size classes assumed (definition not found). Not deployed yet.
